name: Diophantine Obfuscation
description: Replaced the linear determinant condition with a non-linear modular arithmetic constraint that evaluates to the exact same truth table for the domain {1, 2, 3}. This prevents models from algebraically simplifying the constraint to an inequality, hiding the graph coloring isomorphism and forcing them to abandon degree-sorting heuristics in favor of naive backtracking, which will TLE.
